about_the_game:
The Memphis Chronicles is a mysterious tragi-comedy set in a place between worlds.

After a canoe trip goes sideways, you swim to the surface of the lake and emerge in a city filled with questions.

Over the course of a day you can hope to discover what you’re doing here, who you are, and what connects: an elephant, well-dressed demons, an elusive arsonist, a homeless prophet, the Beatles, Stravinsky, the subterranean ruins of a long-lost civilisation, and you.

Wander through eerily familiar spaces, encounter enigmatic creatures, and peer into memories to find the comforting, unsettling and sometimes hilarious stories of Memphis. 

Progress happens in your mind, nothing keeps you from moving forward. You unveil as much of the mystery as you care to observe. Everything left unseen is forever left behind.

Every step takes you deeper into memory and meaning. The only way is forward.

No matter where you’re from, Memphis is home.

Activities: 

  • Find your meaning : This is a game about you, and your observations.

  • Grasp the mysterious laws of Memphis : There’s method to the madness.

  • Peek into the lives of others: Be the voyeur you always wanted to be.

  • Reveal why you’re here: The eternal question.

  • Perform strange rituals: games, dance, fun. 

Featuring: 

  • A richly detailed and realistic world.

  • A lush original score.

  • A cast of beautifully realised characters.

content_descriptors.notes: This game deals with the subjects of death and psychological trauma.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 1080 / AMD RX 6000 / Intel® Arc™ A550
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: ssd recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600 / Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD RX 6700 / Intel® Arc™ A770
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: ssd recommended

short_description: Welcome to Memphis, a city you can only visit once. A place where dreamers and the dead dance. Explore Memphis in the first person, uncover mysteries, and maybe even learn a bit more about yourself. You can’t bring any friends, but everyone you need is already here. This is the trip of a lifetime.
